note: Fixed 2026-10-21 BEFORE any bundle number in this file was computed (ADR 0020). Only the ADR 0018 numbers (EW long/short bundles on full DEV, unscaled bp) had been seen. DEV-only diagnostic: no validation window, no locked TEST, no IW1, no ledger write, never a gate or promotion evidence. A change needs a new file (v2) with a reason.

universe.state: DEV-only evolve state dir regenerated with the R6 command
universe.members: every strategy with status RESEARCH_ONLY at stage dev_screen in that context (expected 64)
universe.bias: members were chosen by the DEV screen on the same DEV days, so H1 and H2 both carry member-selection bias; only the bundle rule fitted on one half and scored on the other is out of sample for the bundle step

returns.events: pipeline._study on the DEV window of each member symbol (the same call as dev_evaluate), re-run per cost model
returns.booking: net return of each event on its exit UTC day (stats_mc.daily_series convention), no mark-to-market
returns.sizing: capital 1 per strategy, split equally over its symbols; on one symbol each event gets 1/K, K = the most positions of that strategy open at the same time on that symbol over DEV. Gross exposure of a strategy and of every bundle never exceeds 1x

cost_models.stress: assumed_public_v1 (taker 5bp + half spread 2bp + slippage 3bp per side; the IW1 cost)
cost_models.gross: same events before cost and funding (report only)

split: the common DEV day grid of all members, H1 = first half of the days, H2 = the rest

bundles.rule: 1/3 each to the equal-weight long, short and symmetric groups (a missing group's share goes to the others equally)

Pearson correlation of member daily returns on the fit half, average-linkage clustering, cut at distance 1 - corr = 0.5; in each cluster the member with the best fit-half Sharpe; equal weight across clusters
bundles.fit: H1 -> scored on H2, and H2 -> scored on H1

bundles.rule: weights proportional to 1 / (daily sd on the fit half), members with sd 0 get 0
bundles.fit: H1 -> scored on H2, and H2 -> scored on H1

market_reference: BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT 50/50 buy-and-hold, daily close-to-close from the same 15m bars on the same day grid; beta and correlation per half; beta-hedged return = bundle - beta_fit_half * market

stable_label.name: DEV_STABLE
stable_label.rule: descriptive label, not a gate: for the scored half (B3/B4) or for both halves separately (B1/B2): primary-cost annual Sharpe >= 0.5 AND annual return > 0 AND max drawdown <= 15% AND stress-cost annual return > 0 AND beta-hedged primary-cost annual return > 0
